inputs.text: Black spade marks ONLY on him; red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Stained glass style depiction of a midnight rendezvous on a moonlit balcony, intricate details, vibrant colors: the spade king with short silver-grey hair, black spade crown and black-silver armor stands facing the diamond queen with very long red-orange hair, diamond tiara and white gown, both her arms visible at her sides with defined hands, stone balustrade and night garden with roses below, full moon and swinging lanterns above, every element cut colored glass with black lead came in midnight blues, silver, ruby and gold, glowing with its own light
